name: Búrc Búiredach
text: Búrc Búiredach was the father of a famed princess. That daughter was the legendary Érne. She placed her name upon a great waterway. The waterway is the river Erne. Érne left a lasting mark upon the land. Búrc Búiredach appears nowhere else in the tales. His honour rests upon his daughter. He gave Ireland a princess who named the Erne waterway.

okr.objective: Record Búrc Búiredach as the father of the princess Érne.
key_results: Name Búrc Búiredach as Érne's father.
Link Érne to the Erne waterway.
